script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune, your watery ruling planet, sits in Aries in your 2nd House of Finances and forms a luminous trine to Jupiter in Leo in your 6th House of Work. Meanwhile, the Sun in Cancer forms a gentle sextile to Neptune, illuminating your 5th House of Pleasure. This rare water-fire alignment empowers practical magic through your sensitive element. Singles attract soulful water-sign lovers through artistic gatherings as Venus blesses the 5th House of Romance. Partnered Pisces must watch for escapist fantasies creeping into the 7th House of Union before they undermine trust. The 2nd House trine signals unexpected income from an intuitive side project, while the 10th House of Career demands scrutiny of a sudden promotion offer. Beware of overidealizing a colleague's vague pitch, yet expect a secret blessing from the 12th House by nightfall. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
